data.title: House committee moves to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
data.summary_raw: A House committee advanced a bill to create a strategic bitcoin reserve, which would codify Trump's plan for permanent bitcoin holdings.

data.title: Bitcoin, ether swing after unanimous quarter-point Fed rate hike as Warsh takes aim at inflation
data.summary_raw: Bitcoin and ether whipsawed as the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years.

data.title: ‘Go time’: SEC, CFTC prepare to push crypto rules as Clarity Act stalls in Senate
data.summary_raw: CFTC Chair Mike Selig said his agency is "locked in and ready to ship its rules for the new frontier of finance."

data.title: House panel approves first federal crypto tax framework, one day after Senate’s Clarity Act stumbles
data.summary_raw: The House Ways and Means Committee voted to advance crypto tax legislation, sending it to the House to consider.
